entries.subject: authenticated user
entries.action: Provide a missing email address so the account can be completed and the user can continue into the account area.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN the chapter editor screen has not finished loading the chapter record, the textarea must remain disabled.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN the user clicks 발행하기, the screen must call publishChapterAction(workId, chapterId, isPaid ? (priceTier ?? PRICE_TIERS[0]) : null), using null for a free chapter and a paid tier selected from PRICE_TIERS when paid.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN the user clicks 회차 저장, the screen must submit the current content through saveChapterContentAction(workId, chapterId, content) and show toast.success('저장했어요.') on success or toast.error(result.error ?? '저장하지 못했어요. 잠시 후 다시 시도해주세요.') on failure.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN the user clicks 발행 취소, the screen must require confirmation in a dialog before calling unpublishChapterAction(workId, chapterId).

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN unpublishChapterAction(workId, chapterId) completes, the screen must set isPublished to false and show a success toast on success, or show the error toast fallback on failure.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN the user interacts with mentions or the AI panel, the screen must apply the visible client-side guards for mention deduplication, caret-based autocomplete, blocked sends during active generation or empty trimmed input, and proposal save availability only when a proposal exists and no other save is in progress.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The screen must provide a navigation link from /studio/:workId to /studio/{workId}/chapters.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The screen must render work?.title for the heading and use work?.synopsis || '' for the synopsis area.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The screen must fetch work data only when a current Supabase user exists, and the work lookup must be filtered by both owner_id and id.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN `submitCreateWork` runs, it must call `createClient` and `supabase.auth.getUser`; IF no user is found, it must return the login-required error instead of creating the work.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHILE the create-work submission is pending, the `새 작품 만들기` button must remain disabled.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: IF `createWork` returns failure, the screen must show a visible destructive error message inline above the form using the returned error, or `작품을 만들지 못했어요.` when no specific error is available.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN the user clicks `새 작품 만들기`, the screen must call `submitCreateWork` with `title`, `trimmed-or-null synopsis`, and `genre`.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN `createWork` succeeds, the screen must navigate to `/studio/{workId}`.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHILE `title.trim()` is empty, the screen must keep the `새 작품 만들기` submit button disabled.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN the callback request is parsed, the handler must read `next` from `searchParams` and use `'/'` as the default destination when `next` is absent.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN `exchangeCodeForSession(code)` succeeds and returns `data.user`, IF `needsEmailCompletion(data.user)` is true, the handler must redirect the user to `/auth/complete-email`.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: IF `code` is missing, or `exchangeCodeForSession(code)` returns an `error`, or `data.user` is absent, the handler must redirect to `/auth/auth-code-error`.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN the callback request includes `code`, the handler must call `createClient()` and `supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code)`, and it may redirect to the destination path only if the exchange returns no `error` and `data.user` exists.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The editor must keep the textarea disabled until the node content request has finished successfully and `content` has been set from `result.content`.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The editor must prevent save submission before loading completes or while a save is already pending, and it must report save outcomes through toast messages.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The editor must submit saves using the current `workId`, `nodeId`, and textarea `content`, and a successful save must trigger revalidation of the current node route.

entries.subject: visitor
entries.action: Browse ranked and filtered works from the home discovery screen.

entries.subject: authenticated user
entries.action: Resume reading from recent activity while browsing the home discovery screen.

entries.subject: authenticated user
entries.action: Close their account safely and end their current session.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The studio work list must provide a create-work entry point in both the header and the empty state.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The studio work list must show the empty state when there are no works to display.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The studio work list must exclude deleted works.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The studio work list must provide a per-work navigation path to the selected work's detail page.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The studio work list must render work cards in most-recent-first order and must not fail when synopsis is missing.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The studio work list must load and display only works associated with the current authenticated user's id.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN POST /account action invokes deleteAccountAction, the handler must read the current user with supabase.auth.getUser() before starting deletion work.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN the profile soft-delete completes successfully during account closure, the handler must end the current session.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: WHEN deleteAccountAction closes an authenticated user's account, softDeleteAccount must update profiles where id = userId and deleted_at is null.

entries.subject: authenticated user
entries.action: Review your current writing projects in Studio and continue with an existing work or start from the empty-state create prompt.

entries.subject: authenticated reader
entries.action: Become a writer account with the minimum required profile setup.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The previous and next chapter links must navigate to the neighboring chapter only when that adjacent chapter is available; otherwise the corresponding link must be disabled.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: On mount, the reader must call chapter-open tracking for every open, and it must upsert reading_progress only when the chapter is not locked and a user exists.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The screen must fall through to notFound() when either the public work or the public chapter is missing.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The reader must render the centered payment-preparation message instead of chapter.content when the chapter is locked.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: When the reader opens or submits 신고, the reporting flow must enforce login checks, and it must reject submissions that choose 기타 without detailed content.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: Font size changes must stay within 17, 19, 21, and 24, and theme changes must stay within light, sepia, and dark.

entries.subject: authenticated user
entries.action: Review a work's core details and continue to chapter-level work.

entries.subject: visitor
entries.action: Sign in with a supported social account to begin an authenticated session

entries.subject: System
entries.action: If the provided `/login` screen variant is implemented exactly as shown, the sign-in UI does not present separate loading, empty, or error states in the visible source.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: When the `/login` screen initiates Supabase OAuth for either supported provider, it must set the redirect target to `/auth/callback` under the current window origin.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: When a user starts sign-in from `/login`, the screen must offer only the Google and Kakao OAuth actions shown in the source and must start sign-in through `supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth` for the selected provider.

entries.subject: authenticated user
entries.action: Update reusable story knowledge content so later writing stays consistent.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: A missing authenticated user must be redirected to /login.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: A profile that is missing or not active must be signed out before redirecting to /login.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The screen must show 이메일 with user.email, show 필명 with profile.pen_name only for writer profiles, and otherwise show the /write/start link labeled 글쓰기 시작하기.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: When 계정 탈퇴하기 submits deleteAccountAction for an authenticated user, the system must call softDeleteAccount(admin, user.id), clear pen_name_bio, set deleted_at only if deleted_at is null, sign out the current session, and redirect to /login.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The chapters tab must disable the main reading action when there are no public chapters; otherwise it must route to the progress chapter when `progress` exists or to the first chapter when it does not.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The screen must require authentication before it allows `toggleSubscriptionAction(workId)`, `toggleBookmarkAction(workId)`, `toggleLikeAction(workId)`, or opening the report flow.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: When the screen loads, it uses the route `workId` to fetch the public work, and the screen is unavailable if no work is returned.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The report form must show and require `상세 내용` only when `신고 사유` is set to `기타`.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The system must reject chapter creation unless the requester is authenticated, the target work is owned by that requester, and any supplied folder is both in the same work and a `회차` folder node.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: When a chapter is created successfully for a work, the chapter must receive the next `order_index` after that work's current maximum and the user must be routed to the created chapter detail screen.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The create-chapter submit action must remain unavailable while a submission is pending or while `title.trim()` is empty.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The chapter list screen must fetch chapters only when an authenticated user is present; otherwise it must render using an empty chapter list.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The chapter list must present non-deleted chapters for the selected work in ascending `order_index`, and it must provide navigation to both chapter detail and new-chapter creation routes.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The system must only attempt chapter reordering when the drag operation changes the order, and the reorder action must require an authenticated requester with a valid owned work context before it succeeds.

entries.subject: User encountering a login error
entries.action: Return to the sign-in flow after a failed or interrupted login attempt.

entries.action: View and organize the chapters of a work from the chapter list screen.

entries.action: Revise, save, and publish chapter content from the studio chapter editor

entries.action: Read a public chapter and control the reading experience

entries.action: Report a problem encountered while reading a chapter

entries.subject: user
entries.action: Complete external sign-in and reach the correct next step after the authentication callback.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: Invalid email input must be rejected before the account email update proceeds.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The email completion screen must use the route error parameter to decide whether to render visible error text and must submit the email form to `submitEmail`.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: Successful completion of the email update must continue the user to the account page.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: Provider-side email update failures must be surfaced by redirecting the user back to the completion route with an error query value.

entries.subject: authenticated user
entries.action: Express interest in a work or report a problem while viewing the work detail page.

entries.subject: reader
entries.action: Review a work's overview and available chapters before deciding whether to continue reading or engage.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The failed-login error screen must provide navigation back to '/login' through the visible '로그인 페이지로 돌아가기' link, and no other user action is confirmed in this variant.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The failed-login error screen must render static recovery copy in a centered layout and must not introduce form, tab, list, or modal interactions on this variant.

entries.subject: authenticated user
entries.action: Review account details, profile state, and relevant account actions from the account settings area.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: Authenticated access is required for both the `/write/start` page and the `submitWriterUpgrade` submission path.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: A writer upgrade may proceed only when `penName` trims to a length from 2 to 20 characters.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The upgrade changes only the authenticated user's `profiles` row when that row still has `role = 'reader'`.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The writer-upgrade flow reports outcomes through redirects rather than a JSON response body.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The home screen must show the centered empty state copy when `works.length === 0`. Otherwise it must render the feed as cards in a 2-column grid on small screens and a 3-column grid on `sm` screens, with every `FeedCard` linking to `/works/{work.id}`. Inside each card, the screen must show the cover image when `coverImageUrl` exists, show `표지 없음` when it does not, and display view and like counts using `formatKoreanCount`, which keeps raw numbers below 10,000 and uses a `만` suffix at 10,000 or above.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The home discovery screen must derive `sortMode` as `latest` or `popular`, derive `sortBasis` as one of `trending`, `views`, `likes`, or `ctr`, and fall back to `popular` and `trending` for unsupported values. The filter UI must default `genre` to `전체` when no genre is present.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: `FeedFilters` must render with the current genre and sort state, and changing genre or sort must push a new route that preserves `#weekly-ranking`. On genre change, the route must update the `genre` query. On click `최신`, the route must set `sortMode=latest`, clear `sortBasis`, and jump to `#weekly-ranking`. On click `인기`, the route must set `sortMode=popular` and jump to `#weekly-ranking`.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: `FeedFilters` must show the ranking-basis select only when `sortMode` is `popular`, and when shown it must update `sortBasis` from the selected supported value.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: When `RecentlyReadSection` has no items, the screen must show the empty copy and the anchor button `작품 둘러보기` that jumps to `#weekly-ranking`.

entries.subject: System
entries.action: The home screen must call `supabase.auth.getUser()` to determine the current user, call `listRecentlyRead(supabase, { userId: user.id, limit: 10 })` only when a `user` exists, and render `RecentlyReadSection` only when `loggedIn` is true.

entries.subject: authenticated user
entries.action: Create a new work with a required title and optional synopsis and genre.
